accessResearch.scope: Offline research directions, not executed probes, installation approval or a universal root method.

nextCapabilities.next: Reuse supplied facts; collect only missing values through available authorized information getters. Root is not universally required for model/chip queries.
Inspect HiUtils_createRequest and vowOS.service.syncExecute separately. Classify CSP, origin, transport, absent API and argument errors; native-code toString output is not a permission result.

accessResearch.continuation: Keep a private hypothesis/result/next-step ledger. A missing exact guide or one rejected interface does not end useful authorized research; pivot on source evidence, not blind retries.

resultInterpretation.rule: Separate structured response status from returned file text. A permission property in source is not a denial; ENOENT applies to the exact path and context, not every registry or file route.
resultInterpretation.priority: Resume from established evidence on this unit. Prefer its working interface and readable sources; repeat only after a relevant premise changes or a necessary current-state check.
resultInterpretation.completeness: Incomplete source does not establish a complete argument/dispatcher contract. Source availability is not runtime write or privilege evidence.

communityObservations.finding: Owner reports two bounded marker write/readback/removal runs followed by a diagnostic package whose postinst produced a UID 0/GID 0 proof. The package/service call was accepted and the helper had been read back against the local original. This project has only the shared report, not the underlying proof and session logs. Diagnostic cleanup was prepared but its completion was not reported. Active maintenance access, independent recovery and native Home remain unverified.

Resolve duplicate/reload-triggered mutation locally. Keep diagnostic pages passive on load, reject duplicate action identifiers and reconcile ambiguous results before any retry.
Determine cleanup and current authorized access separately from historical postinst success. Retain private evidence before removing owned artifacts within existing scope.

Continue PORTING.md with this device's original Home/SDK, verified backups and independent recovery; prepare a static native candidate first. A privilege report never approves native installation or another TV.
